after.name: Jeanneau - DB 37 OB
standardInclusions:
A Unique Line Delivering Style and Performance
Elegance and power are at your service aboard the DB 37 OB.  Boasting a distinguished, contemporary silhouette, as if sculpted, by Camillo Garroni, this premium day boat, with a hull designed by Michael Peters, demonstrates its full capacity while cruising. Fast, agile, and easy to handle, the DB 37 OB flies across the water, powered by twin outboard engines, promising impressive top speeds… to the thrill of the pilot. Sporty cruising in complete safety passengers are not forgotten aboard this sporty, yet protective boat, with a wide, integrated windscreen, two comfortable seats beside the pilot, two modular facing bench seats, which can be removed for an opening onto the sea… and for those who love the sea spray, a sundeck in the forward cockpit is accessible via two perfectly secure, recessed sidedecks. At anchor, her side terraces can be deployed for even more space on board.  Access to the sea is also facilitated by her vast aft swim platform.  Gathered around the cockpit table in the saloon, guests enjoy an uninterrupted field of view, open to the scenery and the horizon.  Parties, dinner with friends, or soaking up the warmth of the sun between dives… the choice is yours.  But that’s not all:  designed for shared pleasures, this day boat invites you to extend your cruise, with her two bright and comfortable, spacious cabins.
NB: Factory Specifications are Subject to Change without notice

after.name: Jeanneau - DB 43 OB
standardInclusions:
A Powerful, Luxurious, Distinguished Day Boat
Boasting a strong outboard engine, the DB 43 OB offers sporty, responsive driving, with top speeds approaching 40 knots. Excellent performance is accompanied by remarkable seakeeping abilities and comfortable cruising, notably due to the hull by Michael Peters. A uniquely distinguished profile sets the tone for this boat, with a sparkling, contemporary design. Bathed in light, the spacious owner's cabin offers surprising levels of finish and comfort. Guests are accommodated in a superb full-beam cabin. But it is on deck, under the sun or in the moonlight, where the most memorable moments will be shared. In the airy cockpit, an inviting saloon accommodates up to eight people around a modular table. The superbly equipped central island galley contributes to a festive atmosphere, enabling you to prepare and savour tasty dishes together. Afterward, two side terraces can be deployed to form a wide, lateral swim platform. In this Beach Club atmosphere, guests can dive into turquoise waters or relax and sunbathe on the sundeck.

The secure windscreen and excellent ventilation provide optimal comfort for all on board. The central helm station, equipped with copilot seating, enables you to share a sporty cruising experience. This fun new day boat is ideal for enjoying fast, comfortable cruising on the water. Each living space aboard has been designed for you to experience special shared moments. Portside, the large terrace, a key element for a boat of this category, invites extended moments of relaxation at the water’s edge. Space for sunbathing and swimming! Whether you are seeking shared moments around an inviting cockpit table, tranquillity and a clear, open deck for fishing, or a moment for relaxing in the sun on the spacious sundeck, the modular cockpit adapts to suit all preferences! Multiple versions will suit your cruising plans to perfection, for an onboard experience to reflect you. On the interior, the layout combines simplicity and efficiency, with well-ventilated living spaces and optimised storage. The companionway’s wide steps provide easy, safe access to the interior. The layout and furnishings feature a wide range of functionality. The cabin is truly a cosy nest, ideal for a refreshing siesta, making this boat your perfect partner for a day at sea.

after.name: Jeanneau - DB 37 OB
standardInclusions:
A Unique Line Delivering Style and Performance
Elegance and power are at your service aboard the DB 37 OB.  Boasting a distinguished, contemporary silhouette, as if sculpted, by Camillo Garroni, this premium day boat, with a hull designed by Michael Peters, demonstrates its full capacity while cruising. Fast, agile, and easy to handle, the DB 37 OB flies across the water, powered by twin outboard engines, promising impressive top speeds… to the thrill of the pilot. Sporty cruising in complete safety passengers are not forgotten aboard this sporty, yet protective boat, with a wide, integrated windscreen, two comfortable seats beside the pilot, two modular facing bench seats, which can be removed for an opening onto the sea… and for those who love the sea spray, a sundeck in the forward cockpit is accessible via two perfectly secure, recessed sidedecks. At anchor, her side terraces can be deployed for even more space on board.  Access to the sea is also facilitated by her vast aft swim platform.  Gathered around the cockpit table in the saloon, guests enjoy an uninterrupted field of view, open to the scenery and the horizon.  Parties, dinner with friends, or soaking up the warmth of the sun between dives… the choice is yours.  But that’s not all:  designed for shared pleasures, this day boat invites you to extend your cruise, with her two bright and comfortable, spacious cabins.
NB: Factory Specifications are Subject to Change without notice

after.name: Jeanneau - DB 43 OB
standardInclusions:
A Powerful, Luxurious, Distinguished Day Boat
Boasting a strong outboard engine, the DB 43 OB offers sporty, responsive driving, with top speeds approaching 40 knots. Excellent performance is accompanied by remarkable seakeeping abilities and comfortable cruising, notably due to the hull by Michael Peters. A uniquely distinguished profile sets the tone for this boat, with a sparkling, contemporary design. Bathed in light, the spacious owner's cabin offers surprising levels of finish and comfort. Guests are accommodated in a superb full-beam cabin. But it is on deck, under the sun or in the moonlight, where the most memorable moments will be shared. In the airy cockpit, an inviting saloon accommodates up to eight people around a modular table. The superbly equipped central island galley contributes to a festive atmosphere, enabling you to prepare and savour tasty dishes together. Afterward, two side terraces can be deployed to form a wide, lateral swim platform. In this Beach Club atmosphere, guests can dive into turquoise waters or relax and sunbathe on the sundeck.

after.name: Cap Camarat - 9.0 CC S2
standardInclusions: The Cap Camarat 9.0 CC Series 2 is the family boat, combining comfort and performance. With her streamlined hull design and styling, you can enjoy smooth cruising in all weather. The secure windscreen and excellent ventilation provide optimal comfort for all on board. The central helm station, equipped with copilot seating, enables you to share a sporty cruising experience. Featuring remarkable manoeuvrability, even for a novice, with reactivity and precision. The full-sized display screen features the latest generation in navigation tools to guide you on all your day cruises. This fun new day boat is ideal for enjoying fast, comfortable cruising on the water. Each living space aboard has been designed for you to experience special shared moments. Portside, the large terrace, a key element for a boat of this category, invites extended moments of relaxation at the water’s edge. Space for sunbathing and swimming! Whether you are seeking shared moments around an inviting cockpit table, tranquillity and a clear, open deck for fishing, or a moment for relaxing in the sun on the spacious sundeck, the modular cockpit adapts to suit all preferences! Multiple versions will suit your cruising plans to perfection, for an onboard experience to reflect you. On the interior, the layout combines simplicity and efficiency, with well-ventilated living spaces and optimised storage. The companionway’s wide steps provide easy, safe access to the interior. The layout and furnishings feature a wide range of functionality. The cabin is truly a cosy nest, ideal for a refreshing siesta, making this boat your perfect partner for a day at sea.
NB: Factory Specifications are Subject to Change without notice
